SELECT r.position_id AS positionId, p.title, p.data_source AS sourceCode, IF(c.short_name IS NOT NULL AND c.short_name <> '', c.short_name, c.company_name) AS companyName, p.city, p.province, p.tech_direction AS techDirection, p.salary_min AS salaryMin, p.salary_max AS salaryMax, p.salary_months AS salaryMonths, p.education, r.match_score AS matchScore, r.cf_score AS cfScore, r.content_score AS contentScore, r.rank_no AS rankNo, r.reason FROM spark_recommend r INNER JOIN job_position p ON p.id = r.position_id INNER JOIN ent_company c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.algo = 3 AND r.is_latest = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM job_application a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.position_id = r.position_id AND a.deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY r.rank_no ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT p.id AS positionId, p.title, p.data_source AS sourceCode, IF(c.short_name IS NOT NULL AND c.short_name <> '', c.short_name, c.company_name) AS companyName, p.city, p.province, p.tech_direction AS techDirection, p.salary_min AS salaryMin, p.salary_max AS salaryMax, p.salary_months AS salaryMonths, p.education, p.apply_count AS applyCount, IFNULL(sp.expect_city, '') AS expectCity, IFNULL(sp.expect_direction, '') AS expectDirection, IFNULL(sk.skill_names, '') AS skillNames, IF(sp.expect_direction IS NOT NULL AND sp.expect_direction <> '' AND p.tech_direction = sp.expect_direction, 1, 0) AS directionHit, IF(sp.expect_city IS NOT NULL AND sp.expect_city <> '' AND p.city = sp.expect_city, 1, 0) AS cityHit, ( IFNULL(sk.skill_weight, 0) * 8 + IF(sp.expect_direction IS NOT NULL AND sp.expect_direction <> '' AND p.tech_direction = sp.expect_direction, 40, 0) + IF(sp.expect_city IS NOT NULL AND sp.expect_city <> '' AND p.city = sp.expect_city, 30, 0) + IF(sp.education IS NULL OR p.education = 0 OR p.education <= sp.education, 10, 0) + LEAST(IFNULL(p.apply_count, 0), 30) ) AS rawScore FROM job_position p INNER JOIN ent_company c ON c.id = p.company_id LEFT JOIN stu_profile sp ON sp.user_id = #{userId} AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.position_id, SUM(ss.proficiency) AS skill_weight, GROUP_CONCAT(st.name ORDER BY ss.proficiency DESC, st.id SEPARATOR '/') AS skill_names FROM job_position_tag t INNER JOIN stu_skill ss ON ss.tag_id = t.tag_id AND ss.user_id = #{userId} AND ss.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN skill_tag st ON st.id = ss.tag_id AND st.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.position_id ) sk ON sk.position_id = p.id WHERE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM job_application a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.position_id = p.id AND a.deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY rawScore DESC, p.apply_count DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limitSize}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.data_source AS sourceCode, IF(c.short_name IS NOT NULL AND c.short_name <> '', c.short_name, c.company_name) AS companyName, p.city, p.province, p.tech_direction AS techDirection, p.salary_min AS salaryMin, p.salary_max AS salaryMax, p.salary_months AS salaryMonths, p.education, ( IFNULL(ov.cnt, 0) * 3 + IF(p.tech_direction = base.tech_direction, 2, 0) + IF(p.city = base.city, 1, 0) ) AS rawScore FROM job_position p INNER JOIN ent_company c ON c.id = p.company_id INNER JOIN job_position base ON base.id = #{jobId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t2.position_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM job_position_tag t1 INNER JOIN job_position_tag t2 ON t2.tag_id = t1.tag_id AND t2.deleted = 0 AND t2.position_id <> t1.position_id WHERE t1.position_id = #{jobId} AND t1.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t2.position_id ) ov ON ov.position_id = p.id WHERE AND p.id <> #{jobId} ORDER BY rawScore DESC, p.apply_count DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limitSize}

SELECT batch_no AS batchNo, algo, k, precision_at_k AS precisionAtK, recall_at_k AS recallAtK, ndcg_at_k AS ndcgAtK, coverage, user_count AS userCount, alpha, cf_method AS cfMethod FROM spark_recommend_eval WHERE deleted = 0 AND is_latest = 1 ORDER BY FIELD(algo, 'cf', 'content', 'hybrid', 'popular'), k

SELECT MAX(batch_no) AS batchNo, COUNT(*) AS recommendCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS userCount, COUNT(DISTINCT position_id) AS positionCount FROM spark_recommend WHERE algo = 3 AND is_latest = 1 AND deleted = 0
